title: Among schools with locally funded charter status, identify those whose K-12
question: Among schools with locally funded charter status, identify those whose K-12 to ages 5–17 enrollment difference exceeds the average for such schools. For these schools, return the administrator's first name, district, and the school’s eligible free meal rate for students aged 5–17, but only if the administrator’s first name is among the two most common first names across all school administrators.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_041 AS school_id,
        s.XCL_080 AS admin_first_name,
        s.XCL_046 AS district,
        f.XCL_019 AS enroll_k12,
        f.XCL_024 AS enroll_5_17,
        f.XCL_025 AS free_meals_5_17,
        (f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024) AS enroll_diff
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    WHERE s.XCL_065 = 'Locally funded'
      AND f.XCL_013 = 1
),
avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(enroll_diff) AS avg_enroll_diff
    FROM base
),
top_admin_names AS (
    SELECT XCL_080 AS admin_first_name
    FROM schools
    WHERE XCL_080 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY XCL_080
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT
    b.admin_first_name,
    b.district,
    CAST(b.free_meals_5_17 AS REAL) / b.enroll_5_17 AS eligible_free_meal_rate_5_17
FROM base b
CROSS JOIN avg_diff a
WHERE b.enroll_diff > a.avg_enroll_diff
  AND b.admin_first_name IN (SELECT admin_first_name FROM top_admin_names)

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_041 AS school_id,
        s.XCL_080 AS admin_first_name,
        s.XCL_046 AS district,
        f.XCL_019 AS enroll_k12,
        f.XCL_024 AS enroll_5_17,
        f.XCL_025 AS free_meals_5_17,
        (f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024) AS enroll_diff
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    WHERE s.XCL_065 = 'Locally funded'
      AND f.XCL_013 = 1
),
avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(enroll_diff) AS avg_enroll_diff
    FROM base
),
top_admin_names AS (
    SELECT XCL_080 AS admin_first_name
    FROM schools
    WHERE XCL_080 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY XCL_080
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT
    b.admin_first_name,
    b.district,
    CAST(b.free_meals_5_17 AS REAL) / b.enroll_5_17 AS eligible_free_meal_rate_5_17
FROM base b
CROSS JOIN avg_diff a
WHERE b.enroll_diff > a.avg_enroll_diff
  AND b.admin_first_name IN (SELECT admin_first_name FROM top_admin_names)

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_041 AS school_id,
        s.XCL_080 AS admin_first_name,
        s.XCL_046 AS district,
        f.XCL_019 AS enroll_k12,
        f.XCL_024 AS enroll_5_17,
        f.XCL_025 AS free_meals_5_17,
        (f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024) AS enroll_diff
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    WHERE s.XCL_065 = 'Locally funded'
      AND f.XCL_013 = 1
),
avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(enroll_diff) AS avg_enroll_diff
    FROM base
),
top_admin_names AS (
    SELECT XCL_080 AS admin_first_name
    FROM schools
    WHERE XCL_080 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY XCL_080
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT
    b.admin_first_name,
    b.district,
    CAST(b.free_meals_5_17 AS REAL) / b.enroll_5_17 AS eligible_free_meal_rate_5_17
FROM base b
CROSS JOIN avg_diff a
WHERE b.enroll_diff > a.avg_enroll_diff
  AND b.admin_first_name IN (SELECT admin_first_name FROM top_admin_names)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_041 AS school_id,
        s.XCL_043 AS admin_first_name,
        s.XCL_042 AS district,
        f.XCL_019 AS enroll_k12,
        f.XCL_024 AS enroll_5_17,
        f.XCL_025 AS free_meals_5_17,
        (f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024) AS enroll_diff
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    WHERE s.XCL_065 = 'Locally funded'
      AND f.XCL_011 = 'Charter School'
),
avgd AS (
    SELECT AVG(enroll_diff) AS avg_diff FROM base
),
top2 AS (
    SELECT XCL_043 AS admin_name
    FROM schools
    WHERE XCL_043 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY XCL_043
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT
    b.admin_first_name,
    b.district,
    CAST(b.free_meals_5_17 AS REAL) / b.enroll_5_17 AS eligible_free_meal_rate_5_17
FROM base b
CROSS JOIN avgd a
WHERE b.enroll_diff > a.avg_diff
  AND b.admin_first_name IN (SELECT admin_name FROM top2)

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH locally_funded_charter AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_041 AS school_id,
        s.XCL_042 AS district,
        s.XCL_043 AS admin_first_name,
        f.XCL_019 AS k12_enrollment,
        f.XCL_020 AS ages_5_17_enrollment,
        f.XCL_021 AS eligible_free_meal_rate_5_17
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    WHERE s.XCL_044 = 'Charter' AND s.XCL_045 = 'Locally Funded'
),
avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(k12_enrollment - ages_5_17_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment_diff
    FROM locally_funded_charter
),
top_admin_names AS (
    SELECT XCL_043 AS admin_first_name
    FROM schools
    GROUP BY XCL_043
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT 
    lfc.admin_first_name,
    lfc.district,
    lfc.eligible_free_meal_rate_5_17
FROM locally_funded_charter lfc
JOIN avg_diff ad ON 1=1
JOIN top_admin_names tan ON lfc.admin_first_name = tan.admin_first_name
WHERE (lfc.k12_enrollment - lfc.ages_5_17_enrollment) > ad.avg_enrollment_diff
